method: Web research 2026-10-15 from search-engine summaries of the cited pages (pages not opened directly).
overview: Capco is a management and technology consultancy for financial services (banking, capital markets, wealth and asset management, insurance) and energy and commodities trading, with 5,000+ consultants in 30+ locations. Wipro acquired it in 2021 for about $1.45bn.
business_type: Financial-services management and technology consulting (owned by Wipro)

differentiators.text: Specialist in financial-services transformation, working with boards and C-suites of banks, insurers and asset managers; part of Wipro since 2021.
differentiators.significance: Deep FS exposure; much of the work combines business change with technology delivery.

culture.text: At the acquisition, both CEOs described similar cultures (a press-release claim, not evidence of employee experience).

tradeoffs.text: Financial-services focus with a technology-delivery tilt; strategy-only roles are less common.
tradeoffs.significance: Check whether a role is advisory or delivery.

unknowns: Graduate program, benefits and flexibility in the US.
Whether Wipro ownership changed day-to-day culture.

sources.title: Business Wire: Wipro to acquire Capco
